mapper.sql: sbp.id, sbp.create_user_id, sbp.create_user_name, sbp.create_time, sbp.update_user_id, sbp.update_user_name, sbp.update_time as updateTime, sbp.version, sbp.is_deleted, sbp.b2c_so_id as b2cSoId, sbp.b2c_so_code as b2cSoCode, sbp.delivery_id as deliveryId , sbp.delivery_code as deliveryCode, sbp.delivery_status as deliveryStatus, sbp.delivery_qty as deliveryQty, sbp.sku_id as skuId, sbp.warehouse_id as warehouseId, sbp.virtual_warehouse_id as virtualWarehouseId, sbp.frozen_time as frozenTime, sbp.frozen_qty as frozenQty, sbp.outstock_order_id as outstockOrderId, sbp.outstock_order_code as outstockOrderCode, sbp.outstock_order_type as outstockOrderType, sbp.outstock_order_status as outstockOrderStatus, sbp.outstock_order_time as outstockOrderTime, sbp.outstock_qty as outstockQty, sbp.parent_sku_id as parentSkuId, sbp.bom_version as bomVersion, pd.sku_no as skuNo, pd.name as productName, wh.name as warehouseName, vw.name as virtualWarehouseName
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM so_b2c_processing where is_deleted = false and bill_date >= #{startDate}
mapper.select:
select
from so_b2c_processing sbp left join so_b2c sb2c on sbp.b2c_so_id = sb2c.id and sb2c.is_deleted = false left join product_detail pd on sbp.sku_id = pd.id and pd.is_deleted = false left join warehouse wh on sbp.warehouse_id = wh.id and wh.is_deleted = false left join virtual_warehouse vw on sbp.virtual_warehouse_id = vw.id and vw.is_deleted = false where ${params.sqlMap.default} and sbp.is_deleted = false
and sbp.outstock_order_id != ''
and sbp.frozen_qty != 0 and sbp.delivery_id != '' and sbp.outstock_order_id = ''
and sbp.outstock_order_id = '' and sbp.frozen_time is not null and EXTRACT(DAY FROM (now() - sbp.frozen_time)) >= 7
${params.permissionSql}
ORDER BY
${item.field} ${item.sort}
sbp.b2c_so_id DESC,sbp.delivery_id desc

select sbd.create_time as billDate, sbd.source_id as b2cSoId, sbd.source_code as b2cSoCode, sbd.id as deliveryId, sbd.code as deliveryCode, sbd.status as deliveryStatus, sbd.delivery_time as deliveryTime, sbdd.id as deliveryDetailId, sbdd.delivery_qty as deliveryQty, sbdd.sku_id as skuId, sbdd.warehouse_id as warehouseId, sbdd.virtual_warehouse_id as virtualWarehouseId, sbd.create_time as frozenTime, sbdd.delivery_qty as frozenQty, '' as outstockOrderId, '' as outstockOrderStatus, 0 as outstockQty, '' as outstockOrderCode, null as outstockOrderTime, '' as outstockOrderType from so_b2c_delivery sbd inner join so_b2c_delivery_detail sbdd on sbd.id = sbdd.main_id and sbdd.is_deleted = false where sbd.is_deleted = false and sbdd.virtual_warehouse_id != '' and sbd.status != 'cancelDelivery'
and sbd.create_time >= #{startDate}
